Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Technology | Technology Innovare Limited secures strategic AI, privacy, and information security management systems implementation partnership with Izwe Africa 20 October 2026 7:00am Audio By Carbonatix
Innovare Limited, a leading management consulting and technology solutions provider, today announced a landmark governance and management systems implementation partnership with Izwe Africa, a licensed pan-African financial services provider.
Under the new partnership, Innovare will design, deploy, and scale a custom Integrated Management System (IMS) that builds on Izwe’s existing ISO/IEC 27001-certified Information Security Management System (ISMS) and adds an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) and Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)to accelerate Izwe Africa’s digital transformation goals.
The multi-phase implementation aligns with ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701 standards to strengthen Izwe Africa’s processes and management capability through an effective risk-based approach, addressing privacy and data governance and the responsible development of AI solutions.
Commenting on the partnership, Nii Djan Mensah, Chief Executive Officer of Innovare Limited, said: “ The partnership comes at a critical time as industries increasingly look toward secure, mature AI platforms with proper governance structures to combat rising risks, protect privacy, control operational costs and manage fragmented business data.”
Both companies are committed to high standards of security, privacy and data governance, and the partnership is designed to ensure that AI at Izwe is used responsibly, securely and with clear accountability.
Innovare Limited is a wholly Ghanaian-owned management consulting and technology services company committed to driving organizational performance excellence. Since its establishment in 2006, the company has empowered enterprises, large and small, to achieve sustainable growth through the adoption of global best practices, innovative solutions and implementation of standards such ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, PCI DSS, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) and compliance with regulatory requirements.
Over the years, Innovare has evolved from a consulting and training company into a dynamic company that is focused on delivering measurable impact across diverse sectors.
Izwe Africa is an established credit provider operating in Ghana, Kenya and Zambia. It serves economically active individuals, entrepreneurs and business owners with a range of financial solutions including purpose-based loans, asset-backed loans and, in Ghana, savings and investment solutions to contribute to the development of each country as a whole. Since expanding from South Africa in 2008, it has followed a steady and managed upward progression and continually focused on developing a world-class business through strategic location choices.
